backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, request management, technicians, feedback, and inventory with access control and helper utilities.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented frontend files tied to reusable image components and refactors.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries describing all frontend components, pages, hooks, utils, and styling files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions using warm OKLCH colors for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with main pages including admin dashboard under a shared layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/InventoryS: Provides an interface to view inventory, add new items, update quantities, and highlight low‑stock parts.
frontend/src/components/admin/SparesUsag: Allows admins to log spare part usage by selecting tickets, technicians, items, and quantities.
frontend/src/components/admin/Technician: Displays customer feedback filtered by technician, showing average ratings and individual reviews.
Displays technician performance by calculating assigned, completed, and pending requests using fetched data.
Renders a dropdown of technicians fetched from the backend for selection.
Manages listing and creation of technicians with a form and table, using query hooks for data and mutations.
frontend/src/components/admin/UsageRepor: Generates a usage report of spare parts by aggregating inventory log quantities.
frontend/src/components/AppImage.tsx: Reusable image component with lazy loading, async decoding, and graceful fallback on error.
frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx: Brand logo wrapper using AppImage with size variants and styled fallback.
frontend/src/components/CategoryGrid.tsx: Grid of service category cards using AppImage and routing to the request form on click.
frontend/src/components/ContactInfoCompa: Compact contact info widget showing email, phone, and location based on selected mode.
frontend/src/components/feedback/Feedbac: Allows customers to submit a rating and optional comments for a service ticket.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/PageLayout.tsx: Defines the main page layout with header, routed content, and a detailed footer including branding, contact info, and social links.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Wraps protected content and prompts users to sign in via Internet Identity if not authenticated.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Renders a responsive site header with navigation links, branding, contact info, and admin-aware menu items.
frontend/src/constants/branding.ts: Defines centralized branding details such as logo, company name, and contact information.
frontend/src/constants/serviceCategories: Provides service category definitions with images and helper functions to fetch category info.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for authentication, identity loading, and login state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for creating, fetching, filtering, and managing requests and user profiles via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard page that validates admin access, displays request metrics, filters requests, and assigns technicians.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page handling Internet Identity authentication and redirecting verified admins.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Public homepage featuring branding, service categories, features, and a call-to-action to book service.
frontend/src/pages/MyRequestsPage.tsx: Displays the logged‑in user's service requests with loading, error, empty, and table views.
frontend/src/pages/RegisterRequestPage.t: Form page for creating service or spares requests with validation and submission using createRequest, then redirecting to a success page.
frontend/src/pages/RequestDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific request including status, category, and feedback, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/RequestSuccessPage.ts: Success screen showing the submitted request ID and navigation options to home or request details.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Lists service categories with descriptions and images, allowing users to start a request for a selected category.
frontend/src/pages/TrackStatusPage.tsx: Allows users to look up request status using ticket ID and phone number, showing results or errors accordingly.
Computes aggregate metrics from a list of requests, including totals and counts by status and assignment.
frontend/src/utils/adminRequestsView.ts: Provides search, filtering, and sorting utilities for displaying request lists in the admin UI.
frontend/src/utils/brand.ts: Defines common appliance brands and utilities to convert between brand objects and display strings.
frontend/src/utils/csvExport.ts: Converts an array of Request objects into CSV text and triggers a file download, including field escaping and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides helpers for formatting bigint nanosecond timestamps into readable or short date strings.
frontend/src/utils/requestStatus.ts: Maps RequestStatus values to human-readable labels and corresponding UI variants.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based query values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, existing features, new feature requests, and overall project state.
